captures.description: 'The Gravity Well Protocol (often referenced as EA-GW-SPEC-01) is a conceptual protocol specification and infrastructure layer designed to restore structural provenance, quality, and governance to AI-mediated content.' (SciLynk) EA-GW-SPEC-01 named directly in the lead sentence. Expanded — Core Concepts: 'Instead of acting as a traditional platform, the protocol operates as an ambient, retentive field that re-anchors scattered digital content and citations back to authoritative archives. Key operational pillars include' (Zenodo): Governed Continuity ('framework to trace content through a structured lifecycle from the moment it is GENERATED through to being RATIFIED' — SciLynk); Provenance Infrastructure ('establishes a minimal core data model (TrackedObject) using structural evidence to ensure AI outputs remain trustworthy and accountable' — SciLynk); Authority Boundaries ('distributes verification responsibilities across four distinct layers: the protocol, individual platforms, digital...'). Below organic: Zenodo 'Gravity Well Protocol: Governed Continuity for AI-Mediated Content' (Apr 1, 2026); Saint Mary's University physics demo also surfaces (correct disambiguation). Strong basin — the framework retrieves under its EA spec ID.
